Why Public Sector Logs Require Blockchain Anchoring

Traditional databases rely on internal database administrators who possess unrestricted write and delete permissions. GovChain Sentinel enforces mathematical finality.

1. Cryptographic Chain of Custody

Every event links to the cryptographic hash of the preceding entry. Any historical alteration completely fractures the chain, making silent modifications mathematically impossible.

2. EVM Merkle Root Anchoring

Aggregates thousands of government events into balanced binary Merkle trees. Roots are permanently minted to Solidity contracts with block height and timestamp seals.

3. Zero-Trust Public Verifiability

Enables courts, auditors, journalists, and citizens to independently verify any land title deed, treasury payout, or police chain-of-custody using a lightweight Merkle proof.

4. Instant Breach Telemetry

If an insider performs an unauthorized SQL query or alters a file on disk, real-time SOC alarms trigger instantly, pinpointing the exact corrupted record and diff.
